title: House halts DICT budget talks over online safety concerns

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House of Representatives late Wednesday held off from further discussing the Department of Information and Communications Technology’s (DICT) proposed 2027 budget, as lawmakers flagged online safety concerns during floor debates on the agency’s spending plan. Philreca party-list Rep. Presley de Jesus motioned that debates on DICT’s P10.68 billion be deferred as lawmakers would rather await the results of its efforts to curb harmful online content, crack down on scams and secure agreements with social media platforms. “This committee must also be able to determine what happened after those actions were initiated,” he told lawmakers on the floor.
